text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein meets Republican Guard commanders
- Saddam's envoy to Sudanese president arrives in Khartoum
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz visits Moscow
- First shipment of French wheat to arrive in Iraq end of March
- Arab League urges the United Nations to expedite flow of food to Iraq
- (The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Commentary accuses United States of black hatred against Iraq
- French pharmaceutical firms seek deals with Iraq
- Transport ministry readies fleet of trucks to ferry food and medicine from ports to Iraqi provinces
- National Assembly discusses private sector participation in oil industries.
